user.title: HomeID account
user.description: Enter the email address of the Philips HomeID account your airfryer is already paired with. A login code will be emailed to you.

code.title: Enter login code
code.description: Enter the code that was emailed to {email}.

appliance.title: Select airfryer
appliance.description: Cloud control works for appliances migrated to HomeID FUSION. Local control needs the appliance's LAN address and local credentials from the account.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in again
reauth_confirm.description: The HomeID login has expired. A new code will be emailed to you.

error.invalid_auth: The code or account was rejected.
error.not_registered: This email is not a fully registered HomeID account. Finish registration in the HomeID app.
error.backend_error: The HomeID backend could not load this account. Open the HomeID app once and try again.
error.host_required: Local control needs the appliance's LAN address.
error.no_local_credentials: The account has no local credentials for this appliance. Use cloud control.
error.unsupported: This appliance is not a supported SPECTRE airfryer or has no cloud registration.
error.cannot_connect_device: Could not connect to the airfryer. Check that it is powered on and online.

abort.no_appliances: No appliances were found in this HomeID account.
abort.backend_error: The HomeID backend could not load this account.
abort.not_registered: This email is not a fully registered HomeID account.

device_not_found.message: The selected device is not a loaded HomeID airfryer.

nothing_to_update.message: Provide a temperature, duration, or remaining time.

start_cooking.name: Start cooking
start_cooking.description: Configure the airfryer and start cooking. The drawer must be closed; the start is confirmed by the appliance.

preset.name: Program
preset.description: Built-in program. Temperature and duration still apply.

recipe_id.name: Custom preset ID
recipe_id.description: Optional HomeID custom preset short ID.

update_settings.name: Update settings
update_settings.description: Change temperature or time of an active or paused cook.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: New temperature in the appliance's current unit.

keep_warm.name: Keep warm
keep_warm.description: Start keep warm at 80 °C for up to 30 minutes.
